connector.name: klanex
connector.registryDescription: Reliable async execution for agent tool calls: schema gating, retries, idempotency, audit trail.
connector.summary: Hosted at api.klanexai.com over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package klanex-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the chrassy account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: KLANEX_API_KEY
env.description: klanex API key; klx_test_... keys route to the sandbox automatically
